about.alhamdulillahBody: All praise belongs to Allah, who revealed His Book and made it easy to remember. Qariah was built out of love for the Qur'an and for the women whose voices carry it. We ask Allah to accept this small effort and make it a source of good for our daughters and for the whole Ummah.
about.missionBody: Qariah celebrates the recitation of the Holy Qur'an by women — contemporary and historical, gathered from across the world and across many narrations. We've brought over 60 qariahs into one calm, beautiful space, so that every listener — and especially the next generation of girls — can hear the Qur'an in a voice that feels like their own.
about.commitmentBody: We're committed to honoring these qariahs, and the Book they recite, with the care it deserves. Qariah will stay a respectful, thoughtfully curated home for the Qur'an, and we'll keep adding qariahs and refining the experience, insha'Allah. Thank you for being part of this journey. May Allah accept it from us all.

0.title: A new Qariah, built on Bayaan
0.description: Qariah has been rebuilt from the ground up on top of Bayaan, the open-source Quran app. You get a modern app and design with a much fuller feature set — and Qariah's mission stays the same: celebrating contemporary women reciters.

1.title: Reciters with translations
1.description: New reciters with translations of the Quran into English, Spanish, Russian, and more — alongside the classical Hafs catalog. Translation reciters are tagged on every profile.

2.title: Rich reciter profiles
2.description: Every reciter now has a profile with their photo, country, bio, recitation count, and the rewayat they recite in. Browse by country with stylized country badges.

3.title: Curated Listen tab
3.description: A redesigned Listen tab with stacked Reciter and Surah pills, a tall Shuffle pill, and curated rows: Honored Reciters, Paradise Reciters, Newly Added, Full Recordings, Stories of the Prophets, and more.

4.title: Multiple rewayat
4.description: Read and listen in eight rewayat — Hafs, Warsh, Qalun, Al-Bazzi, Qunbul, Shu'bah, Al-Duri, and Al-Susi — with per-letter and whole-word diff highlighting in the mushaf.

5.title: Full mushaf with tajweed
5.description: The complete Uthmani mushaf with tajweed coloring, ayah-by-ayah follow-along highlighting, page jumps, bookmarks, and an immersive reading mode.

6.title: Sign in to restore your favorites
6.description: Sign in with your Quran Foundation account to automatically restore your favorite reciters and surahs from the original Qariah app. Or export and import your data from Settings › Your Data.

7.title: Offline downloads & custom playlists
7.description: Download individual surahs or entire playlists for offline listening. Create your own playlists, or use curated ones like Surahs of the Prophets and Stories from the Quran.

8.title: Open source
8.description: Qariah is open source on GitHub. Star the repo, report issues, or open a pull request. Link in Settings › Contribute on GitHub.
